Normal Polearms
(Exceptional Polearms | Elite Polearms)

Larger, heavier, and more cumbersome than even the most massive of axes, the various polearms do incredible amounts of damage in a single blow. Pole arms can be unwieldy and so are always held in two hands. They require a great deal of strength as well.

Polearms speeds are listed by Class: Ama = Amazon, Asn = Assassin, B = Barbarian, D = Druid, N = Necromancer, P = Paladin, S = Sorceress.
